role: Private runtime adapter between stable HOUSE semantics and Home Assistant device/entity state and service execution.
invariant: HA entity/device identity is an alias/binding, never canonical HOUSE identity.

rules: Entity rename must not create a new HOUSE object.
New HA entities never silently inherit an existing HOUSE ID.
Replacement is an explicit binding transition.
Many HA entities may bind distinct capabilities of one HOUSE object.
Runtime/vendor identifiers remain private aliases/evidence where possible.

observations.rule: Current state is a projection/reduction over observations; adapter restart must not fabricate semantic change.

availability.rule: Last known value may remain inspectable when unavailable, but must never be presented as current runtime truth without qualification.

stale.rule: Persistent state does not become stale merely from event silence. Periodic/ephemeral capabilities use declared stale thresholds.

on_resync: reload HA registry/state needed by bound capabilities
reconnect.rule: Ordinary network interruption should converge without semantic repair or manual ritual.

intent.rule: HOUSE submits typed Intent; adapter does not expose arbitrary unrestricted HA service calls through the normal seam.
intent.pipeline: INTENT -> mapping validation -> capability validation -> permission/policy -> HA translation -> runtime -> observation/receipt

receipts.rule: Every attempted external action has a receipt; SENT or HTTP success is not CONFIRMED until runtime/world evidence justifies confirmation.

shadow.effect: Compile the exact HA operation and emit WOULD_SEND without executing it.
shadow.promotion_gate: Replay/reconnect/identity tests pass and a capability is explicitly allowlisted for act mode.

removal.runtime_entity_disappeared: HOUSE object remains; binding becomes MISSING.
removal.device_or_integration_replaced: Old binding becomes REPLACED; new binding becomes BOUND; HOUSE identity/history remains.
removal.house_object_retired: Explicit HOUSE lifecycle decision only; operational binding is removed while observations, receipts, mappings and provenance remain.

acceptance_tests: unavailable is independent from last capability value
periodic sensor becomes stale by declared threshold
persistent state does not stale from silence alone
missing entity does not delete HOUSE object
duplicate entity cannot silently claim an existing HOUSE ID
every external action has a receipt
diagnostics explain broken mappings without leaking secrets
unbind removes execution authority but preserves history
adapter restart converges without manual semantic repair
